title: C++ - Advanced weird overloads[Type Casting]
description:
You can also convert type casting functions, using the signature:
```cpp
operator <TypeName>() const; // Yes, no return type, it is known by the type you overload!
// e.g.
operator int() const;
```
Const is there for the same reason as those QOL functions in the fixed size array class: it says "C++ I don't modify the class when this is called".
